answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 9 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 1030 identities costs 1030 real chips plus the bond on each. The mirror of the binding is one-to-one, the sable of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the thread of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
